placements.why: Both expressions are directives commanding the erasure of specific institutional knowledge — a prior decision and a migration topic — naming an organizational domain concerned with what knowledge is retained or removed. No existing strata or narrative leaf covers this category.
placements.title: Knowledge Governance
placements.frame: What decisions shape what the organization remembers, forgets, or removes?

placements.title: Erasure as Authority
placements.frame: When does authority manifest as the removal of what the group knows rather than the decision of what to do next?
placements.why: Both expressions are flat imperatives commanding the erasure of institutional knowledge without consultation or rationale — authority exercised through unilateral removal rather than forward-looking decision. This names a thematic subject (knowledge erasure as an authority act) that future envelopes could feed, not a one-time fact.
